description: The Lange Vechtbrug is a double wooden drawbridge over the Vecht in Weesp. From it, narrow brick houses and warehouses with stepped and bell gables line the Hoogstraat quay. The sky is mainly clear, about 12.3°C, with wind near 1.8 km/h, and a bright moon is up. The church tower and the neoclassical town hall stand inland on Nieuwstraat and are not the subject.
